chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Isma'il ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever from whom land is taken, then he remains for three years not seeking it, it would not be permissible for him after three years that he seeks it.

key_terms.لَمْ يَحِلَّ لَهُ: it would not be permissible for him

ai.seo_question: What is the time limit for reclaiming land after it has been taken?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes a specific legal limit (ajal) for reclaiming lost property, emphasizing the principle that prolonged neglect of one's rights leads to their forfeiture. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling highlights the balance between protecting ownership and preventing the stagnation of land use, reflecting the broader Islamic legal maxim that 'delay in claiming rights may lead to their loss.'
